tasks.name: Prepare completions and commissioning execution plan
tasks.description: Sets the completions philosophy: MC, RFC, RFSU and handover definitions, ITR scheme, punch categories, certificate flow and systems used.

needs.info: project execution plan and contracting strategy
owner handover requirements, operating organisation and acceptance criteria

tasks.name: Develop preliminary system list and start-up sequence
tasks.description: Defines commissioning systems from PFDs and utility diagrams and sets the high-level start-up order (utilities first).

needs.info: PFDs and utility flow diagrams with unit and utility configuration
operating philosophy: start-up and shutdown sequence
operations start-up priorities and existing utility availability

tasks.name: Mark system and subsystem boundaries on P&IDs
tasks.description: Marks colour-coded system and subsystem limits on P&IDs and single-lines, including isolation points.

needs.info: P&IDs IFD with line numbers, valves and equipment tags
single-line diagrams with switchboard and feeder IDs
ICS architecture and control system cabinets
tie-in list and test package limits
preliminary system list

tasks.name: Set commissioning sequence and required subsystem turnover dates
tasks.description: Builds the commissioning schedule by system and gives construction the required MC/turnover date per subsystem.

needs.info: system and subsystem register
level 2 schedule and start-up milestone
path of construction and CWP sequence

tasks.name: Define ITR library and ITR matrix by tag type
tasks.description: Defines A (construction), B (pre-commissioning) and C (commissioning) check sheets and maps them to discipline tag types.

needs.info: instrument types used in the instrument index
electrical equipment types and site test requirements
equipment types and vendor pre-commissioning requirements
owner check sheet standards and witness points

tasks.name: Build tag-to-subsystem register
tasks.description: Assigns every tag (lines, equipment, instruments, cables, electrical equipment) to a subsystem from the engineering lists.

needs.info: line list: line number, from/to, P&ID number
equipment list: tag, type, P&ID number
instrument index from SI: tag, type, loop, P&ID number
cable schedule and electrical equipment list from SPEL
piping specialty and manual valve list with tags
system boundary P&IDs

tasks.name: Load tags and assign ITRs in Smart Completions
tasks.description: Loads the tag register into Smart Completions by spreadsheet and generates the ITR set per tag from the ITR matrix.

needs.info: tag-to-subsystem register
ITR matrix
list of engineering list revisions (deltas) after each IFC re-issue

tasks.name: Write pre-commissioning procedures
tasks.description: Writes flushing, blowing, chemical cleaning, drying, leak test and inerting procedures by system.

needs.info: P&IDs, operating conditions and cleanliness requirements
line classes, flushing connection points and test packages
vendor pre-commissioning requirements (exchangers, compressors, heater dry-out)
vendor IOM manuals and preservation requirements

tasks.name: Write commissioning and function test procedures
tasks.description: Writes system commissioning, run-in and function test procedures, including SIS and C&E testing.

needs.info: control narrative and operating philosophy
cause and effect matrix and SRS
protection settings and energisation sequence
draft operating procedures

tasks.name: Define commissioning spares, consumables and first fills
tasks.description: Lists commissioning spares, lubricants, chemicals, catalysts, filters and gases needed by system and date.

needs.info: SPIR commissioning spares and lubrication schedules
first-fill requirements (catalyst, packing, lube oil)
chemical injection and catalyst requirements

tasks.name: Define vendor commissioning support requirements
tasks.description: States vendor representative scope, man-days and timing per package for pre-commissioning and start-up.

needs.info: PO scope and rates for vendor site services
commissioning schedule by system

tasks.name: Plan temporary commissioning facilities
tasks.description: Defines temporary spools, strainers, blinds, flushing pumps, nitrogen and steam supply needed for pre-commissioning.

needs.info: 3D model and isos at flushing connections and spool breaks
pre-commissioning procedures
existing utility availability (N2, steam, water) for commissioning

tasks.name: Track test pack status by subsystem
tasks.description: Tracks test pack status (prepared, tested, reinstated) against subsystems to forecast MC.

needs.info: pressure test packs with line lists
pressure test and reinstatement records

tasks.name: Raise and manage punch lists
tasks.description: Records punch items from walkdowns by subsystem with A/B/C category and action-by party and tracks them to closure.

needs.info: punch clearance status
owner walkdown findings

tasks.name: Accept subsystem turnover from construction
tasks.description: Accepts MC subsystems from construction after checking A-ITRs and A punch and takes custody for pre-commissioning.

needs.info: MC certificate and construction quality dossier
completed A-ITRs

tasks.name: Execute pre-commissioning (B-ITRs)
tasks.description: Carries out flushing, cleaning, insulation tests, motor solo runs and other B-ITRs and records them per tag.

needs.info: pre-commissioning procedures and ITR assignments
vendor representative attendance and records

tasks.name: Execute loop checks
tasks.description: Checks each loop from field device to DCS/SIS graphic and records loop status and defects.

needs.info: loop diagrams, I/O list and instrument datasheets (ranges, alarm set points)
DCS/SIS configuration loaded and FAT punch closed
power and UPS available to control system cabinets

tasks.name: Execute C&E and SIF function tests
tasks.description: Tests every cause and effect line and SIF end to end and records results against the SRS.

needs.info: IFC cause and effect matrix and SRS with trip set points
SIL requirements and proof test intervals

tasks.name: Energise electrical systems
tasks.description: Energises substations, switchboards and feeders under permit after protection testing and records energisation.

needs.info: protection relay settings and energisation sequence
completed electrical A-ITRs and cable test records
electrical authority permit to energise

tasks.name: Commission systems and confirm ready for start-up
tasks.description: Runs C-ITRs and system run-in tests, closes punch required for start-up and issues RFSU.

needs.info: loop check, C&E test and energisation records
operations crew available, operating procedures approved, owner witness sign-off
pre-start-up safety review findings

tasks.name: Raise commissioning technical queries
tasks.description: Raises queries and modification requests to engineering for design problems found during commissioning.

needs.info: engineering responses and revised P&IDs
engineering responses on set points, ranges and logic

tasks.name: Compile system turnover packages
tasks.description: Assembles the turnover dossier per system: certificates, ITRs, test records, punch, vendor data and as-built list.

needs.info: construction quality dossier
final data books and IOM manuals
as-built drawing status per system

tasks.name: Hand over systems to the owner
tasks.description: Hands over each system with the agreed punch list and turnover package and gets the owner handover certificate signed.

needs.info: handover acceptance and retained punch agreement
complete system turnover package

tasks.name: Report completions progress
tasks.description: Reports ITR, punch and certificate progress by system against the commissioning schedule.

needs.info: Smart Completions ITR, punch and certificate data
reporting calendar and progress measurement rules

tasks.name: Support performance test run
tasks.description: Supports the owner's performance test run and compiles the test data against guarantees.

needs.info: design case and guarantee figures (yields, product specs, utilities)
performance test procedure and acceptance criteria
equipment performance guarantees

items.name: Completions and commissioning execution plan
items.content: Definitions of MC, RFC, RFSU and handover, ITR scheme, punch categories, certificate flow, roles and systems used.

items.name: Preliminary system list and start-up sequence
items.content: System numbers and descriptions, start-up order and preliminary ready-for-commissioning dates.

items.name: System boundary P&IDs
items.content: P&IDs and single-lines colour-marked with system and subsystem limits and isolation points.

items.name: System and subsystem register
items.content: System and subsystem numbers, descriptions, discipline, priority and boundary descriptions.

items.name: Commissioning sequence and required turnover dates
items.content: Subsystem sequence and required MC/turnover date per subsystem; sent to construction and project controls.

items.name: ITR library and ITR matrix
items.content: A/B/C check sheet forms and the mapping of discipline tag types to ITRs.

items.name: Tag-to-subsystem register
items.content: Every tag with discipline, tag type, P&ID and subsystem, ready for spreadsheet load into Smart Completions.

items.name: ITR assignment register
items.content: Tag, ITR, subsystem and status in Smart Completions; the ITR set construction and commissioning must complete.

items.name: Pre-commissioning procedures
items.content: Flushing, blowing, chemical cleaning, drying, leak test and inerting procedures by system.

items.name: Commissioning and function test procedures
items.content: System commissioning, run-in, C&E and SIF test procedures.

items.name: Commissioning spares and first-fill list
items.content: Commissioning spares, lubricants, chemicals, catalysts, filters and gases by system, quantity and need date; sent to procurement and owner.

items.name: Vendor commissioning support requirements
items.content: Vendor representative scope, man-days and call-off dates per package; sent to procurement and vendors.

items.name: Temporary commissioning facility requirements
items.content: Temporary spools, strainers, blinds, pumps and N2/steam/water needs with locations; sent to piping and construction.

items.name: Test pack status by subsystem
items.content: Test packs per subsystem with status (prepared, tested, reinstated).

items.name: Punch list
items.content: Punch items by tag and subsystem: description, category A/B/C, action-by discipline, due date and status.

items.name: Subsystem turnover certificate (construction to commissioning)
items.content: Signed acceptance of MC subsystem custody transfer with exceptions.

items.name: Completed pre-commissioning ITRs (B sheets)
items.content: Signed B-ITR records by tag: flushing, cleaning, insulation tests, solo runs.

items.name: Loop check records
items.content: Loop status, test results and sign-off by loop.

items.name: Loop and configuration defect list
items.content: Defects found in loops: wrong ranges, wiring, tag or graphic errors, with action-by INST or DCS vendor.

items.name: C&E and SIF function test records
items.content: Test results for every C&E line and SIF with response times and sign-off.

items.name: Energisation certificates
items.content: Signed energisation certificates per switchboard and feeder.

items.name: Commissioning ITR records (C sheets)
items.content: Signed C-ITRs and run-in test results by system.

items.name: Ready-for-start-up certificate
items.content: RFSU certificate per system with outstanding punch and pre-start-up safety review closure.

items.name: Commissioning technical query
items.content: Query or modification request to engineering with tags, markups and impact on start-up.

items.name: System turnover package
items.content: Per system: certificates, ITRs, test records, punch, vendor data and as-built list.

items.name: System handover certificate
items.content: Owner-signed handover certificate per system with retained punch.

items.name: Completions progress report
items.content: ITR, punch and certificate progress by system against plan.

items.name: Performance test report
items.content: Measured yields, product quality and utilities against guarantees.
